name: Matsya
description: $matsya_avatar$ is the first [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], represented as a fish. He is thought to protect from floods and aquatic animals.

name: Kurma
description: $kurma_avatar$ is the second [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], represented as a turtle or tortoise. He is equated to the World-Turtle that supports the world on its shell, and is revered for his steadiness and firmness.

name: Varāha
description: $varaha_avatar$ is the third [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], represented as a boar. He is revered for lifting the Earth out of the sea and bringing order from chaos.

name: Narasiṃha
description: $narasimha_avatar$ is the fourth [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], represented as a lion. He is revered as the destructor of evil and protector against persecution.

name: Vāmana
description: $vamana_avatar$ is the fifth [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], represented as a dwarf. He is revered for vanquishing the usurper Bali and returning the rule of the Heavens to Indra.

name: Paraśurāma
description: $parashurama_avatar$ is the sixth [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], represented as a warrior. He is revered for fighting against tyrannical and oppressive kings.

name: Rāma
description: $rama_avatar$ is the seventh [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], and one of the most popular ones. He is the prince acting as the central figure of the epic $ramayana$, and is considered to embody the characteristics of the ideal person and the best follower of the Dharma.

name: Kṛṣṇa
description: $krishna_avatar$ is the eight [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], and one of the most worshiped among all [ShowReligionName('hindu')]. He is the god of compassion, protection, and love.

name: Buddha
description: Siddhartha Gautama, the historical Buddha, is considered the ninth [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')] in [ShowReligionName('hindu')]. He is revered for deceiving the Asuras with his teachings and making them abandon the Dharma, thus assuring the victory of the Devas.

name: Kalki
description: $kalki_avatar$ is the tenth and final [avatar|e] of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')], prophesied to come to end the Kali Yuga, the current period of corruption in the endless cycle of existence. His arrival will usher in the renewal of the world by removing all unrighteousness from it.

name: Durgā
description: $durga_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ strength, motherhood and protection at the same time as destruction and wars.

name: Kālī
description: $kali_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ time, creation, power, destruction, and death. Revered as the slayer of evil, her most significant characteristic is her red tongue sticking out.

name: Pārvatī
description: $parvati_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ love, beauty, fertility and motherhood. She is also the wife of [ShowGodName('shiva_god')].

name: Lakṣmī
description: $lakshmi_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ wealth, prosperity, fortune and abundance. Her appearance as her eight manifestations represents the eight sources of wealth. She is also the wife of [ShowGodName('vishnu_god')].

name: Sarasvatī
description: $saraswati_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ knowledge, art, wisdom, and learning. She is the wife of Brahma, the [god|e] of creation.

name: Chinnamastā
description: $chhinnamasta_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ contradictions, self-sacrifice, death as well as immortality, and self-realization. She is depicted nude and decapitated on top of a copulating couple.

name: Caṇḍī
description: $chandi_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ the destructive power against evil.

name: Tripura Sundarī
description: $tripura_sundari_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ the supreme essence of [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('shakti_god')], the ultimate energy of the universe, and the supreme consciousness.

name: Bhuvaneśvarī
description: $bhuvaneshvari_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ Devī as the World Mother.

name: Tārā
description: $tara_avatar$ $shakti_common_desc$ a fierce aspect of the Devī, similar to [ShowAvatarName('kali_avatar')], but as a guide and protector.
